title: Learning Generative Selection for Best-of-N
authors_zh: Shubham Toshniwal、Aleksander Ficek、Siddhartha Jain、Wei Du、Vahid Noroozi、Sadegh Mahdavi、Somshubra Majumdar、Igor Gitman
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: Automatically verified math and code candidate sets train a 1.7B DAPO policy to reason over Best-of-N solutions and return the index of a verified-correct candidate.
自动验证过的数学与代码候选集用于训练 1.7B 的 DAPO 策略，让它在 Best-of-N 候选上推理并返回一个验证正确候选的编号。
why: It exposes candidate-pool composition, verifier labels, selector rollouts, and selection reward as distinct data objects for the rollout/search/test-time trace track.
inclusion_reason: It turns automatically labeled candidate sets and selector reasoning into an RLVR construction recipe for Best-of-N test-time aggregation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Parallel sampling can raise the probability that at least one candidate solves a reasoning problem, but the system must still identify which candidate to return. Majority voting can favor a repeated wrong answer, independent reward scores do not compare candidates jointly, and prompted generative selection is weak in small models. This paper asks whether a 1.7B reasoning model can learn GenSelect directly through RL. Its data object is a selection episode rather than a newly synthesized solution: a math or code problem, an enumerated set of two to sixteen Qwen3-1.7B candidate solutions, precomputed correctness labels, the selector's comparative reasoning, a final Judgment [IDX], and a scalar reward determined by the label of the chosen candidate. It belongs in the rollout/search/test-time trace track because candidate generation and selector rollout are separate test-time-compute stages whose quality and costs must be audited independently.

并行采样可以提高“至少一个候选解正确”的概率，但系统最终仍要判断返回哪一个候选。多数投票可能偏向重复出现的错误答案，逐候选独立打分无法进行联合比较，而小模型仅靠提示进行生成式选择时表现较弱。本文研究 1.7B 推理模型能否通过 RL 直接学会 GenSelect。其数据对象不是重新合成的答案，而是一条选择 episode：数学或代码问题、由 Qwen3-1.7B 生成的二至十六个编号候选解、预计算正确性标签、selector 的比较推理、最终 Judgment [IDX]，以及由所选候选标签决定的标量奖励。它属于 rollout/search/test-time trace track，因为候选生成与 selector rollout 是相互独立的测试时计算阶段，其质量与成本需要分别审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The construction converts Best-of-N aggregation into a programmatically rewarded RL task. Qwen3-1.7B first supplies candidate solutions; Math-Verify-based symbolic checking labels math candidates, while provided OpenCodeReasoning unit tests label code candidates. A GenSelect prompt asks the same-size selector to compare all candidates and end with an index. DAPO rewards the selector when that index points to any candidate labeled correct. Candidate labels can therefore be precomputed, unlike synthesis-based aggregation where each newly generated answer must be verified online. The contract remains candidate-set conditional: the policy is trained to choose among supplied candidates, cannot repair an all-wrong pool, and inherits every false positive or false negative produced by the automatic verifier.

该构造把 Best-of-N 聚合转化为可由程序化信号奖励的 RL 任务。Qwen3-1.7B 先生成候选解；数学候选由基于 Math-Verify 的符号检查标注，代码候选由 OpenCodeReasoning 提供的单元测试标注。GenSelect 提示要求同为 1.7B 的 selector 比较所有候选，并以索引结束；当该索引指向任一标为正确的候选时，DAPO 给出奖励。因此，候选标签可以预先计算，不像答案合成式聚合那样需要在线验证每个新答案。这个契约始终以候选集为条件：策略只能在给定候选中选择，无法修复全错候选池，并会继承自动 verifier 的所有误报和漏报。

title: Method
方法
html:
For mathematics, the authors start from 37K OpenMathReasoning problems on which Qwen3-1.7B has below-50% pass rate under a Math-Verify-based symbolic verifier. They sample two to sixteen Qwen3-1.7B solutions per prompt, retain sets containing at least one correct candidate but no more than 50% correct candidates, and resample up to four sets per problem. For code, they use OpenCodeReasoning problems and provided tests, execute Qwen3-1.7B candidates to obtain binary labels, and apply the same at-least-one-correct and at-most-50%-correct rules. Prompts over 16K tokens are discarded; code candidate responses over 12K tokens are also discarded. The paper does not report the code-problem count, final constructed-prompt count, candidate-generation temperature, manifest, seeds, or rejected-item log.

Separate Qwen3-1.7B math and code selectors are trained on NVIDIA H100 GPUs with VeRL and on-policy DAPO. The reported batch size is 128, learning rate 1e-6, and optimizer AdamW. Each math prompt receives 16 selector rollouts and each code prompt receives 8; selector sampling uses temperature 1.5, top-p 1.0, and a maximum output length of 16,384 tokens. These rollout counts describe on-policy selection attempts per prompt, not candidate-pool size. Evaluation uses the same GenSelect prompt and averages results over eight runs on AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, and LiveCodeBench v6.

数学数据从 37K 条 OpenMathReasoning 问题开始，这些问题上 Qwen3-1.7B 经 Math-Verify 式符号 verifier 检查后的通过率低于 50%。每个提示采样二至十六个 Qwen3-1.7B 候选解，只保留至少一个正确候选且正确候选不超过 50% 的集合，并可为每个问题重新采样至多四组。代码数据使用 OpenCodeReasoning 问题及其测试，执行 Qwen3-1.7B 候选以得到二元标签，再采用相同的“至少一个正确、正确比例至多 50%”规则。超过 16K tokens 的提示会被删除，超过 12K tokens 的代码候选回复也会被删除。论文未报告代码问题数、最终构造提示数、候选生成温度、manifest、随机种子或被拒条目日志。

数学与代码 selector 分别以 Qwen3-1.7B 为基座，在 NVIDIA H100 上使用 VeRL 和 on-policy DAPO 训练。报告配置为 batch size 128、学习率 1e-6、AdamW 优化器。每个数学提示生成 16 条 selector rollout，每个代码提示生成 8 条；selector 采样使用 temperature 1.5、top-p 1.0，最大输出长度 16,384 tokens。这些 rollout 数表示每个提示的 on-policy 选择尝试数，并非候选池大小。评测沿用同一 GenSelect 提示，并在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 和 LiveCodeBench v6 上对八次运行取平均。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The main table evaluates selection from eight candidates produced by Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, or 8B generators. On Qwen3-1.7B candidate sets, the math-trained 1.7B selector reports 65.00, 54.17, and 36.25 accuracy on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, compared with 48.75, 38.33, and 26.67 for prompted 1.7B GenSelect. On LiveCodeBench v6, the code-trained selector reports 36.84 versus 34.72 for prompted 1.7B GenSelect; the math-trained selector reports 36.45. When candidates come from Qwen3-4B or 8B, the math-trained 1.7B selector remains competitive with larger prompted selectors, supporting transfer beyond the training generator. These results measure selection accuracy under the paper's precomputed labels and candidate distributions. They do not establish that verifier labels are error-free, that the constructed training records are released or licensed, or that higher benchmark accuracy proves higher data quality.

主表评测从 Qwen3-1.7B、4B 或 8B 生成的八个候选中进行选择。在 Qwen3-1.7B 候选集上，数学训练的 1.7B selector 在 AIME24、AIME25 和 HMMT25 上报告 65.00、54.17 和 36.25，而仅提示的 1.7B GenSelect 为 48.75、38.33 和 26.67。在 LiveCodeBench v6 上，代码训练 selector 报告 36.84，仅提示基线为 34.72；数学训练 selector 为 36.45。候选改由 Qwen3-4B 或 8B 生成时，数学训练的 1.7B selector 仍能与更大提示模型竞争，支持其对训练生成器之外的迁移。这些结果衡量的是论文预计算标签和候选分布下的选择准确率，不能证明 verifier 标签无误、构造训练记录已发布或有许可证，也不能用更高 benchmark 准确率证明更高数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: GenSelect itself predates this paper, as do Best-of-N sampling, majority voting, automatic math/code verification, and DAPO. The paper's specific change is to train a small GenSelect policy with RL over deliberately mixed correct and incorrect candidate sets. Selection rather than synthesis makes the reward cheap to compute because all candidate labels are known before the selector rollout; the policy may reason jointly across candidates but must return one existing index. The difficulty controls—source problems below 50% pass rate, at least one correct candidate, and a 50% cap on correct candidates—turn candidate-pool composition into an explicit construction variable. This is a useful direction signal for test-time aggregation, but the reported cross-generator transfer and score gains do not prove that the hidden constructed dataset is complete, representative, or reusable.

GenSelect、Best-of-N 采样、多数投票、数学/代码自动验证和 DAPO 都不是本文首次提出。论文的具体变化，是在有意混合正确与错误解的候选集上用 RL 训练小型 GenSelect 策略。选择而非合成使奖励计算较便宜，因为 selector rollout 开始前所有候选标签已知；策略可以联合比较候选，但必须返回某个已有索引。来源问题通过率低于 50%、至少一个正确候选、正确候选比例至多 50% 等难度控制，把候选池组成变成了显式构造变量。这为测试时聚合提供了有价值的方向信号，但报告的跨生成器迁移与得分提升不能证明未公开构造数据集完整、有代表性或可复用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Every training selection prompt contains at least one verified-correct candidate, so the method does not learn abstention, candidate rejection, or recovery when all candidates are wrong. Math-Verify-based symbolic checking may mishandle equivalent forms or malformed outputs; unit tests can miss bugs, reject otherwise valid programs through runtime or formatting failures, and provide a noisier reward. Filtering to below-50%-pass problems and capping correct candidates at 50% changes the natural Best-of-N distribution, while length filtering can preferentially remove complex solutions. The paper does not disclose the code-training count, final selection-task count, candidate-generation sampling parameters, data manifest, overlap/decontamination procedure, licenses, seeds, compute totals, or item-level failures. No official code, constructed dataset, selector checkpoint, or rollout release was verified. Code gains are smaller and noisier than math gains, and benchmark performance is not evidence that the underlying records are accurate or reusable.

每个训练选择提示都至少包含一个经验证正确的候选，因此该方法没有学习全错候选池上的弃权、拒绝或恢复。基于 Math-Verify 的符号检查可能误判等价形式或异常输出；单元测试可能漏掉 bug，也可能因运行时或格式问题拒绝本来有效的程序，因此代码奖励更嘈杂。筛选通过率低于 50% 的问题并把正确候选比例限制在 50% 以内，会改变自然 Best-of-N 分布；长度过滤还可能优先删除复杂解答。论文未披露代码训练数量、最终选择任务数量、候选生成采样参数、数据 manifest、重叠/去污染流程、许可证、随机种子、总计算量或逐条失败。未核验到官方代码、构造数据集、selector checkpoint 或 rollout 发布。代码增益小于且不如数学稳定，benchmark 表现也不能证明底层记录准确或可复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, this paper supplies a schema for separating candidate generation from candidate selection. A reusable selection record should preserve source dataset and item ID, problem text, generator and sampling parameters, every indexed candidate, raw verifier execution or symbolic result, binary label, candidate-set resampling attempt, filtering reason, ordering, selector checkpoint, selector reasoning, parsed index, format status, chosen-candidate label, scalar reward, and rollout seed. Such records support RLVR selector training, verifier-error audits, studies of pool size and correctness ratio, cross-generator transfer, and test-time-compute accounting. Current reuse is recipe-level only: without released manifests, candidates, labels, selector rollouts, checkpoints, and licenses, the paper does not provide an artifact that can be assumed ready for training.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace track 而言，本文提供了把候选生成与候选选择分开记录的 schema。可复用选择记录应保存来源数据集与条目 ID、问题文本、生成器及采样参数、每个带索引候选、verifier 的原始执行或符号结果、二元标签、候选集重采样次数、过滤原因、候选顺序、selector checkpoint、selector 推理、解析索引、格式状态、所选候选标签、标量奖励和 rollout seed。这类记录可支持 RLVR selector 训练、verifier 错误审计、候选池规模与正确比例研究、跨生成器迁移和测试时计算核算。目前只能复用配方：在 manifest、候选、标签、selector rollout、checkpoint 和许可证尚未发布时，不能把论文视为已经提供可直接训练的 artifact。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Math construction starts from 37K OpenMathReasoning problems; the code-problem count and final selection-prompt counts are unknown.
  • Each prompt contains 2–16 candidates, at least one verified-correct candidate, and at most 50% verified-correct candidates.
  • The 16 math and 8 code rollout counts are on-policy selector rollouts per prompt, not candidate-pool sizes.
  • Selector RL uses temperature 1.5 and top-p 1.0; candidate-generation sampling parameters are unknown.
  • Benchmark gains evaluate selection under automatic labels and do not prove verifier accuracy, data quality, release completeness, or reuse rights.

• 数学构造从 37K 条 OpenMathReasoning 问题开始；代码问题数和最终选择提示数均为 unknown。
  • 每个提示包含 2–16 个候选，至少一个经验证正确的候选，且正确候选比例不超过 50%。
  • 数学 16 条、代码 8 条 rollout 指每个提示的 on-policy selector rollout，并非候选池大小。
  • selector RL 使用 temperature 1.5、top-p 1.0；候选生成采样参数为 unknown。
  • Benchmark 增益只评估自动标签下的选择，不能证明 verifier 准确、数据质量、发布完整性或复用权利。
